I graduated with a BSc in Information Technology from the Faculty of Sciences of the University of Lisbon in 2025. I’m currently pursuing an MSc in Computer Science and Engineering, where my research explores the design of interactive self-awareness tools that help young people better understand their AI usage, encouraging AI literacy, critical reflection, and healthier interactions with AI. My work is supervised by Professor Tiago Guerreiro.

My main interests lie in design and healthcare technologies. Outside of academia, I enjoy playing video games, baking, and staying active through sports.
